1. Parties
This synthetic subscription is between Cloud Vendor and Delta Customer.
2. Services
Provider shall supply access to the test platform while the subscription is active.
3. Payment
Customer shall pay the subscription fee within 15 days of invoice.
4. Renewal
The subscription renews annually unless either party gives 60 days written notice.
5. Notice
Notices must be sent to the contract contact in writing.
6. Data Protection
Customer must not upload real personal data to this synthetic test platform.
